cards.front: Estoy intentando recordar algo.
cards.back: I'm trying to remember something.

cards.front: ¿Qué estás intentando recordar?
cards.back: What are you trying to remember?

cards.front: Estoy intentando recordar lo que quiero explicar.
cards.back: I'm trying to remember what I want to explain.

cards.front: ¿A quién se lo quieres explicar?
cards.back: Who are you trying to explain it to?

cards.front: Estoy intentando explicártelo a ti.
cards.back: I'm trying to explain it to you.

cards.front: Estoy intentando explicarte algo importante.
cards.back: I'm trying to explain something important to you.

cards.front: Intenta escuchar, para variar.
cards.back: Try to listen for a change.

cards.front: Intenta escucharme.
cards.back: Try to listen to me.

cards.front: Intenta escuchar lo que estoy diciendo.
cards.back: Try to listen to what I'm saying.

cards.front: Intenta ser agradable, para variar.
cards.back: Try to be nice for a change.

cards.front: Intenta ser agradable con la gente que tienes a tu alrededor.
cards.back: Try to be nice to the people around you.

cards.front: Intenta ser agradable con la gente en general.
cards.back: Try to be nice to people in general.

cards.front: Algunos de nosotros estamos intentando escuchar la explicación.
cards.back: Some of us are trying to listen to the explanation.

cards.front: Algunos de nosotros estamos intentando trabajar.
cards.back: Some of us are trying to work.

cards.front: Algunos de nosotros estamos intentando dormir.
cards.back: Some of us are trying to sleep.

cards.front: Estoy intentando no llorar, pero esta película es muy triste.
cards.back: I'm trying not to cry, but this film is very sad.

cards.front: Estoy intentando no llorar, pero esta canción es muy romántica.
cards.back: I'm trying not to cry, but this song is very romantic.

cards.front: Estoy intentando no llorar otra vez, pero estoy muy sensible hoy.
cards.back: I'm trying not to cry again, but I'm feeling very sensitive today.

cards.front: Jane, procura no pensar en las partes tristes.
cards.back: Jane, try not to think about the sad parts.

cards.front: Nick, procura no pensar en la letra y disfruta de la canción.
cards.back: Nick, try not to think about the lyrics and just enjoy the song.

cards.front: Beth, procura no pensar demasiado.
cards.back: Beth, try not to think too much.

cards.front: Intentaré no olvidar el champán para la fiesta.
cards.back: I'll try not to forget the champagne for the party.

cards.front: Yo intentaré no olvidar las copas de champán.
cards.back: I'll try not to forget the champagne glasses.

cards.front: Y yo intentaré no olvidar el dinero para pagarlo.
cards.back: And I'll try not to forget the money to pay for it.

cards.front: Intenta no preocuparte por eso; tenemos mucho alcohol.
cards.back: Try not to worry about it; we have lots of alcohol.

cards.front: Intenta no preocuparte por las copas tampoco.
cards.back: Try not to worry about the glasses either.

cards.front: Intenta no preocuparte por nada, ¿vale?
cards.back: Try not to worry about anything, ok?

cards.front: No te rías, pero me voy a probar el esmoquin naranja.
cards.back: Try not to laugh, but I'm going to try on the orange tuxedo.

cards.front: No te rías cuando me lo veas puesto.
cards.back: Try not to laugh when you see me in it.

cards.front: No te rías, ¡pero es que el mío es exactamente igual!
cards.back: Try not to laugh but mine's exactly the same!

cards.front: Sé que es difícil, pero intenta entenderlo.
cards.back: I know it's difficult but try and understand.

cards.front: Sé que estás ocupado, pero intenta llamarme.
cards.back: I know you're busy but try and call me.

cards.front: Intenta estar en casa a la hora de la cena, ¿vale?
cards.back: Try and be home for dinner, ok?

cards.front: Hoy en día, la gente intenta gastar menos dinero.
cards.back: Nowadays, people try and spend less money.

cards.front: ¿La gente intenta gastar menos dinero en estos días?
cards.back: Do people try and spend less money these days?

cards.front: ¿La gente debería intentar gastar menos dinero hoy en día?
cards.back: Should people try and spend less money nowadays?

cards.front: Algún día intentaré aprender un tercer idioma.
cards.back: Someday I'll try and learn a third language.

cards.front: ¿Intentarás aprender un tercer idioma algún día?
cards.back: Will you try and learn a third language someday?

cards.front: Quiero intentar aprender un tercer idioma algún día.
cards.back: I want to try and learn a third language someday.

cards.front: No intentaré aprender un tercer idioma hasta que no domine éste.
cards.back: I won't try and learn a third language till I master this one.

cards.front: No intentaré llamarte hasta mañana.
cards.back: I won't try and call you till tomorrow.

cards.front: No intentes comer hasta que tengas hambre.
cards.back: Don't try and eat till you're hungry.

cards.front: Intentaré visitarte en un mes.
cards.back: I'll try and visit you in a month's time.

cards.front: ¿Intentarás visitarme en un año?
cards.back: Will you try and visit me in a year's time?

cards.front: Intentaré estar allí en dos semanas.
cards.back: I'll try and be there in two weeks' time.

cards.front: Prueba a leer un libro.
cards.back: Try reading a book.

cards.front: Prueba a escuchar música.
cards.back: Try listening to music.

cards.front: Prueba a contar ovejas.
cards.back: Try counting sheep.

cards.back: Why don't you try reading a book?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no pruebas a escuchar música?
cards.back: Why don't you try listening to music?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no pruebas a contar ovejas?
cards.back: Why don't you try counting sheep?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no pruebas a leer un libro sobre pesca?
cards.back: Why not try reading a book on fishing?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no pruebas a leer un libro sobre jardinería?
cards.back: Why not try reading a book on gardening?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no pruebas a leer un libro sobre Sudáfrica?
cards.back: Why not try reading a book on South Africa?

cards.front: Cuando no puedo dormir, pruebo a leer un libro sobre algo aburrido.
cards.back: When I can't sleep, I try reading a book on something dull.

cards.front: Cuando no puedo dormir, pruebo a escuchar música relajante.
cards.back: When I can't sleep, I try listening to relaxing music.

cards.front: Cuando no puedo dormir, pruebo a contar ovejas.
cards.back: When I can't sleep, I try counting sheep.

cards.back: When she has trouble sleeping, she tries reading a book on gardening.

cards.back: When she has trouble sleeping, she tries listening to relaxing music.

cards.back: When she has trouble sleeping, she tries counting sheep.
